object: The controlled set of predicates and entity types that give quads their meaning.  Vocabulary terms are defined in a central file (vocabulary.org) and used as predicates in quads.  Two namespaces: wh: for entity types (wh:per, wh:con, wh:evt...) and v: for relationship predicates (v:pt, v:bt, v:rt, v:sn...).
